note: docs/battles/README.md, the verdict: an army with more than 40% of its men in routed or destroyed bodies for 30 minutes loses (both over: the less broken wins, within 10 points a draw); otherwise the side in possession of the village (within musket range of the crossroads) at 16:00 wins; contested: play on by quarter hours, two hours at most, then a draw. Nothing else scores.
